summary: Fly-E Group, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose that Nasdaq's listing staff has closed a compliance matter related to the late filing of the company's Form 10-Q for the period ended December 31, 2025. The company had received a deficiency notice on February 27, 2026, under Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). After filing the delinquent Form 10-Q on April 21, 2026, Nasdaq determined compliance was achieved. This is an administrative update regarding exchange listing rule compliance and does not constitute a special situation event. There are no deal terms, shareholder actions, or strategic changes. The matter is closed with no further action required.
